Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class ResearchOrchestratorService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.ResearchOrchestratorService
All Implemented Interfaces:
CompareVendorsUseCase, ConductResearchUseCase
public class ResearchOrchestratorService extends Object implements ConductResearchUseCase, CompareVendorsUseCase
Application-layer service that implements ConductResearchUseCase and CompareVendorsUseCase.

This service is the single entry point for the research pipeline. It selects the active execution mode (LEGACY_GOOGLE or STAGED_RESEARCH), dispatches to the correct pipeline branch, and returns a fully assembled ResearchAnswer.

LEGACY_GOOGLE path (always safe, no API keys required):

  1. Build a single RetrievalQuery from the request.
  2. Call legacyAdapter.retrieve() to fetch stored articles.
  3. Assemble citations and wrap in a single-section ResearchAnswer.
  4. Persist a ResearchRun tracking record.

STAGED_RESEARCH path (requires AI + optional Perplexity API key):

  1. ResearchPlanningService.plan(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) decomposes the query into sub-queries.
  2. Each sub-query is dispatched to perplexityAdapter.retrieve().
  3. All sources are pooled and assembled into citations by CitationAssembler.
  4. ResearchSynthesisService.synthesize(java.lang.String, com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.ResearchPlan, java.util.List<com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.RetrievedSource>, java.util.List<com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.SourceCitation>) calls the AI to produce structured sections.
  5. New source articles are persisted via ArticleStoragePort (dedup by URL).
  6. Articles are exported to the NotebookLM corpus via ResearchExportPort.
  7. A ResearchRun tracking record is persisted via ResearchRunPort.

The effective mode is: request.mode() if non-null, else defaultMode.

This class is not annotated with @Service — it is wired as a bean in AppConfig.

  • Method Details

    • conduct

      public ResearchAnswer conduct(ResearchRequest request)
      Execute the research pipeline for the given request and return the assembled answer.

      Routes to the LEGACY_GOOGLE, STAGED_RESEARCH, or COMBINED branch based on the effective mode, then persists a ResearchRun tracking record. For STAGED_RESEARCH and COMBINED runs the Perplexity-sourced articles are also saved as NewsArticle records and exported to the NotebookLM corpus.

      Specified by:
      conduct in interface ConductResearchUseCase
      Parameters:
      request - The research request; must not be null.
      Returns:
      A structured ResearchAnswer; never null.

    • compare

      public VendorCompareResult compare(String query, int maxSources, int minVendors, String scoring)
      Run the vendor comparison pipeline for a free-form query.

      Runs the COMBINED retrieval pipeline (Perplexity + legacy DB) to gather sources, then delegates synthesis to VendorAssessmentService which produces one VendorAssessment per vendor identified in the retrieved corpus. No ResearchRun record is persisted — vendor comparisons are transient.

      Specified by:
      compare in interface CompareVendorsUseCase
      Parameters:
      query - The healthcare AI research question; must not be blank.
      maxSources - Maximum number of source documents to retrieve; must be ≥ 1.
      minVendors - Minimum number of vendor sections to request from the AI; must be ≥ 1.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY" (default).
      Returns:
      A VendorCompareResult containing vendors sorted by relevance descending and the deduplicated source citations evaluated.

    • compareSelected

      public VendorCompareResult compareSelected(List<String> vendorTopics, String focusArea, int maxSources, String scoring)
      Run the vendor comparison pipeline for explicitly selected vendor topics.

      Articles are fetched directly per vendor topic name (e.g. "Anthropic Healthcare"), bypassing query decomposition and relevance filtering. An optional focusArea narrows the AI comparison to a specific healthcare domain.

      Fetches articles directly per vendor topic name, bypassing query decomposition and the lossy filterByQueryRelevance step. Each vendor topic maps to a feed topic in application.yml (e.g. "Anthropic Healthcare").

      Specified by:
      compareSelected in interface CompareVendorsUseCase
      Parameters:
      vendorTopics - Non-empty list of vendor topic names matching feed config topics.
      focusArea - Optional healthcare focus area (e.g. "radiology"); may be null or blank.
      maxSources - Maximum source documents per vendor topic; must be ≥ 1.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY".
      Returns:
      A VendorCompareResult containing vendors sorted by relevance descending.
